contexts.text: They are transmuted into a certain interior sight.
This life cannot be transmuted in a moment into another.
The natural sense is at once transmuted into this spiritual sense.
a. Who transmute the life of their-thoughts and affections into almost no life.
To transmute this life into the opposite is to destroy the spirit.
He did not transmute this human nature from the mother into the Divine essence.
They wished that their infernal delight should be transmuted into heavenly.
I have often observed this transmutation (of apparent into genuine truths) in the Spiritual World.
